fragment_text: (2) Paragraph 1 shall not apply: (a) where the catches contain more than 80% of one or more of the following species— (i)) mackerel, herring, horse mackerel, blue whiting, boarfish, anchovy, argentine, sardine, sprat (i.e. small pelagic fisheries); (ii)) capelin, sandeel, Norwegian pout (i.e. fisheries for industrial purposes); (b) to fishing vessels of less than 12 metres' length overall where catches below the minimum conservation reference size have been sorted, estimated and recorded in accordance with Article 14 of this Regulation.
